name: Routine
description: Routine is an AI-powered workspace that brings tasks, calendars, meetings, notes, projects, and team knowledge into one place. People use it to capture work, plan their time, manage custom databases, and synchronize information from other services.
agentUseSummary: Routine cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because Routine explicitly states that its API is not open to the public and publishes no supported delegated OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP contract for third-party account access.

blocked.label: Connect a Routine account
blocked.description: Routine states that its API is not open to the public and does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract for third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use Routine account data
blocked.description: Routine does not publish the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, permissions, or rate limits needed to read or change a customer's tasks, events, notes, or databases through a public account API.

blocked.label: Run Routine agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot treat Routine's user-facing integrations or Zapier workflows as a general public account API or reverse engineer Routine's private application interface.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Routine opens a supported public account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: Routine's API is not open to the public, and no supported remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
Routine's API is not open to the public, and no supported remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Routine's official API help article explicitly says its API has not been opened to the public, and Routine publishes no supported delegated OAuth, API-key, developer-console, or remote MCP contract for third-party account access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Routine only when the provider opens and documents a supported distributable account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service.

evidence.supports: Routine describes an AI-powered workspace for tasks, meetings, projects, notes, planning, custom databases, and bidirectional integrations.
Routine's official API help article explicitly states that Routine's API has not been opened to the public.
Routine lists its user-facing integrations and requested integration catalog but does not publish a third-party developer console, authorization contract, or public Routine account API.
Routine documents user-configured Zapier triggers and actions as an automation route; it does not present Zapier as a general public Routine account API for third-party applications.
Routine documents connecting other services inside Routine for data synchronization, not authorizing an external application to access a Routine account.
